LOGIN_BAD_CREDENTIALS.summary: Bad credentials or the user is inactive.

detail.reason: Password should be at least 3 characters

VERIFY_USER_BAD_TOKEN.summary: Bad token, not existing user ornot the e-mail currently set for the user.

post.description: Create a product (needs user approval). unit_type: unit, gram (price per kg, stock in grams), liter or pack.

patch.description: Change a product's name, price, stock, min_stock, category or SKU (needs user approval). Get the id from search_products.

post.description: Register a sale (needs user approval). Get item ids from search_products first. Quantity is in grams for gram products. Credit sales need customer_id. Prices come from the catalog unless the user explicitly asks for another price.

get.description: List sales, newest first, paginated (page, size). Optional status filter: completed, cancelled, refunded.

parameters.name: user_id

schema.description: Only records made by this user
schema.title: User Id

parameters.description: Only records made by this user

get.description: One sale with its product lines, totals, payment method and status.

post.description: Cancel (undo) a sale (needs user approval): restores stock and reverses its cashbox entry. Optional body {reason}.

get.description: Revenue, sales count, average ticket and top category. `period` is one of 7d, 30d, 90d, 1y, all (default 30d); or pass start_date/end_date (ISO 8601) for a custom range.
Revenue per product category. `period` is one of 7d, 30d, 90d, 1y, all (default 30d); or pass start_date/end_date (ISO 8601) for a custom range.
Revenue per payment method. `period` is one of 7d, 30d, 90d, 1y, all (default 30d); or pass start_date/end_date (ISO 8601) for a custom range.
Best-selling products by revenue and quantity. `period` is one of 7d, 30d, 90d, 1y, all (default 30d); or pass start_date/end_date (ISO 8601) for a custom range.

Revenue, cost of goods sold and gross margin, plus the most and least profitable products. `period` is one of 7d, 30d, 90d, 1y, all (default 30d); or pass start_date/end_date (ISO 8601) for a custom range.
Revenue over time, one point per date. `period` is one of 7d, 30d, 90d, 1y, all (default 30d); or pass start_date/end_date (ISO 8601) for a custom range.
Inventory value, low-stock products and products with no recent sales.
Cash inflow/outflow totals by movement type. `period` is one of 7d, 30d, 90d, 1y, all (default 30d); or pass start_date/end_date (ISO 8601) for a custom range.

post.description: Register stock received from a supplier (needs user approval). Adds the quantities to stock. Lines without item_id create new products. total_cost_price is the total for the line.

get.description: List purchases from suppliers, newest first, paginated. Filters: q (supplier or reference), payment_status (paid, unpaid, partial), status (received, partial, cancelled).

parameters.name: user_id

schema.description: Only records made by this user
schema.title: User Id

parameters.description: Only records made by this user

get.description: One purchase with its lines, costs, supplier and payment status.

post.description: Cancel (undo) a purchase (needs user approval): removes the stock again and reverses its cashbox entry. Body {reason, force}; it fails with negative_stock unless force=true when units were already sold.
Create a customer (needs user approval). Only name is required.

get.description: Full customer account: contact data, balance, credit sales, payments and other charges.

patch.description: Update a customer's contact data or credit limit (needs user approval).

post.description: Record a payment a customer makes towards their credit balance (needs user approval).

get.description: The open cashbox session with opening amount, cash in/out and expected cash balance. 404 if none is open.

post.description: Open the cashbox with an opening cash amount (needs user approval).
Close the open cashbox session with the cash actually counted (needs user approval).
Record a manual cash income or expense in the open session (needs user approval).

get.description: Recent cashbox movements, optionally for one session_id.
List product category names, optionally filtered by prefix.
Find suppliers by name prefix. Returns id and name.

delete.description: Forget the business's settings and go back to the server defaults.

post.description: Model ids offered by the provider's /models endpoint (empty if it doesn't support it).

get.description: Find products by name, SKU or category words (e.g. 'coca 2l'). Returns id, price, stock and unit_type. For unit_type 'gram' the price is per kilogram and stock is in grams. Always use this to get product ids before creating sales or purchases.

parameters.name: q

schema.description: Words from the product name, SKU or category
schema.title: Q

parameters.description: Words from the product name, SKU or category

get.description: Find customers by name, phone or ID number. Returns id, current credit balance (what they owe) and credit_limit (null = unlimited).
Details for one product: stock, price, last purchase unit cost, and units/revenue sold in the last 30 days.

Today's overview: sales total/count by payment method, whether the cashbox is open and the expected cash in it, low-stock products and customers over their credit limit. Pass tz (IANA timezone). Use this for questions like 'how did we do today?'.

parameters.name: tz

schema.description: IANA timezone used to decide what 'today' is
schema.title: Tz

parameters.description: IANA timezone used to decide what 'today' is

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: Amount the customer pays towards their credit balance

supplier.description: Supplier {id, name}; use search_suppliers for the id, or just a name to create one

payment_status.description: paid (recorded in the cashbox), unpaid or partial

item_id.title: Item Id
item_id.description: Existing product id from search_products; omit to create a new product with item_name

total_cost_price.title: Total Cost Price
total_cost_price.description: Total paid for this whole line, not the unit cost

sell_price.title: Sell Price
sell_price.description: New selling price (per kg for gram products), if the user gives one

overwrite_previous_value.title: Overwrite Previous Value
overwrite_previous_value.description: True to replace the product's existing price/SKU/category with the values given here

payment_method.description: cash, card, other (transfer), credit (customer pays later; requires customer_id) or internal (owner takes goods)

amount_tendered.title: Amount Tendered
amount_tendered.description: Cash handed over by the customer, to compute change

customer_id.title: Customer Id
customer_id.description: Customer id from search_customers; required for credit sales

subtotal_override.title: Subtotal Override
subtotal_override.description: Only when the user asks to charge a different total

item_id.title: Item Id
item_id.description: Product id (look it up with search_products; never invent it)

quantity.title: Quantity
quantity.description: Amount sold. Units for unit/pack/liter products; GRAMS for products with unit_type 'gram' (e.g. 500 = half a kilo)

unit_price_override.title: Unit Price Override
unit_price_override.description: Only when the user explicitly asks for a different price (per kg for gram products)
